schedule: Weekly Mondays: source refresh at 06:15 UTC; evidence review on Monday mornings, Europe/London.
coverage_note: Six-journal homepage coverage meets the 80% target. The denominator is normalized author name groups across all publications in the rolling five-year corpus. Profile-only links and source-restricted pages are flagged in the MS author audit; some namesakes remain possible. R&R records require author or institution evidence.
linkedin_note: Public LinkedIn evidence only. Automated LinkedIn crawling may be blocked; no signed-in or complete LinkedIn coverage is claimed.

jobs.name: OpenPostdoc
jobs.note: All 33 active and archived pages across all fields were scanned. Only European economics, finance and explicitly related postdoctoral records are included; mechanically focused jobs mislabeled Economics are excluded.

jobs.name: Econ Job Market
jobs.note: All six public status pages and all five public position pages were scanned. Public EJM omits some login-only/free advertisements.

author_homepage_coverage.basis: Provisional normalized author name groups. Profile-only links and unreadable sources are separately flagged in the author audit; namesakes remain possible.

ms_author_audit.basis: Normalized author name groups from MS publications. Publication/affiliation matches and profile-only links are reported separately; namesakes remain provisional.

finance_top5_author_homepage_coverage.basis: Normalized author name groups with publications in JF, JFE, RFS, JFQA or RF; homepage eligibility must match a publication in those journals.

conference_author_homepage_coverage.basis: Public program paper authors, normalized names; compatible variants merged when they share a verified dedicated author webpage. Personal websites preferred, with individual institution research profiles as fallback. Name-based identity matches remain provisional where explicitly flagged.
roster_limitations: EFA 2026 doctoral tutorial full roster is not publicly available; its named award winner is included.
SFS Asia-Pacific 2026 program is not yet publicly available.
